dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply falcate trailing edge with a pronounced concave spline extending from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a narrow pixel radius and posterior orientation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepening incline, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark-pigmented irregular patch at the leading edge base of the dorsal fin; numerous small white punctate marks scattered across the visible flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Intense specular highlights on the wet integument; distinct tonal transition from the dark dorsal fin to the lighter reflective skin of the body.
